name: Lifter's Recovery
blurb: Open up hips, hamstrings, chest and shoulders after heavy lifting.

phases.name: Child's pose
phases.cue: Knees wide, arms long, sink your hips back.

phases.name: Cat-cow
phases.cue: Round and arch with your breath.

phases.name: Downward dog
phases.cue: Push the floor away, heels toward the ground.

phases.name: Low lunge, left
phases.cue: Back knee down, hips forward.

phases.name: Low lunge, right
phases.cue: Switch sides.

phases.name: Pigeon, left
phases.cue: Square your hips, fold forward if you can.

phases.name: Pigeon, right
phases.cue: Switch sides.

phases.name: Seated forward fold
phases.cue: Hinge from the hips, long spine.

phases.name: Thread the needle, left
phases.cue: Shoulder and ear to the floor.

phases.name: Thread the needle, right
phases.cue: Switch sides.

phases.name: Supine twist, left
phases.cue: Knees to the side, look the other way.

phases.name: Supine twist, right
phases.cue: Switch sides.

phases.name: Corpse pose
phases.cue: Lie still. Let everything go heavy.

name: Morning Mobility
blurb: Ten minutes to wake up stiff joints before the day.

phases.name: Mountain pose

phases.name: Reach up
phases.cue: Arms up, stretch tall.

name: Hips & Ankles
blurb: Ten minutes to squat deeper and walk easier.

phases.name: 90/90 switches
phases.cue: Sit with both knees bent at 90. Rock the knees side to side.

phases.name: 90/90 hold, left
phases.cue: Tall chest, lean over the front shin.

phases.name: 90/90 hold, right
phases.cue: Switch sides.

phases.name: Deep squat hold
phases.cue: Heels down, elbows push your knees out.

phases.name: Ankle rocks, left
phases.cue: Knee travels over your toes, heel stays down.

phases.name: Ankle rocks, right
phases.cue: Switch sides.

phases.name: Frog rocks
phases.cue: Knees wide, rock your hips back and forward.

phases.name: Couch stretch, left
phases.cue: Back knee against the wall or couch, tuck your hips.

phases.name: Couch stretch, right
phases.cue: Switch sides.

phases.name: Happy baby
phases.cue: Rock gently.

name: Shoulder Rescue
equipment: Mat, a band if you have one
blurb: Eight minutes for tight shoulders and a stiff upper back. Great before pressing.

phases.name: Arm circles
phases.cue: Small to big, both directions.

phases.name: Wall slides
phases.cue: Back to the wall, slide your arms up and down.

phases.name: Thread the needle, left
phases.cue: On all fours, arm slides under.

phases.name: Thread the needle, right
phases.cue: Switch arms.

phases.name: Puppy pose
phases.cue: Hips over knees, chest sinks to the floor.

phases.name: Doorway chest stretch
phases.cue: Forearm on a door frame, step through.

phases.name: Sleeper stretch, left
phases.cue: On your side, gently press the forearm down.

phases.name: Sleeper stretch, right
phases.cue: Switch sides.

phases.name: Band pull-aparts or reverse flys
phases.cue: Squeeze your shoulder blades together.

phases.name: Child's pose
phases.cue: Walk your hands long.

name: Low Back Relief
blurb: Eight easy minutes when your lower back is tight. Gentle, no strain.

phases.name: Knees to chest
phases.cue: Hug and rock side to side.

phases.name: Pelvic tilts
phases.cue: Small, slow movements.

phases.name: Cat-cow
phases.cue: With your breath.

phases.name: Bird dog
phases.cue: Opposite arm and leg, slowly.

phases.name: Glute bridge
phases.cue: Lift and lower slowly.

phases.name: Supine twist, left
phases.cue: Knees to the left.

phases.name: Supine twist, right
phases.cue: Knees to the right.

phases.name: Child's pose
phases.cue: Breathe into your low back.

phases.name: Sphinx pose
phases.cue: Forearms down, chest lifts gently.

name: Full-Body Stretch
blurb: Fifteen minutes, every major muscle. The cool-down you keep meaning to do.

phases.name: Neck stretch
phases.cue: Each side for twenty seconds.

phases.name: Cross-body shoulder, left
phases.cue: Pull the arm across your chest.

phases.name: Cross-body shoulder, right
phases.cue: Switch arms.

phases.name: Triceps stretch
phases.cue: Twenty seconds each arm.

phases.name: Standing quad stretch, left
phases.cue: Hold your foot behind you.

phases.name: Standing quad stretch, right
phases.cue: Switch legs.

phases.name: Standing forward fold
phases.cue: Soft knees.

phases.name: Calf stretch, left
phases.cue: Hands on a wall, back leg straight.

phases.name: Calf stretch, right
phases.cue: Switch legs.

phases.name: Low lunge, left
phases.cue: Hips forward.

phases.name: Low lunge, right
phases.cue: Switch sides.

phases.name: Pigeon, left
phases.cue: Fold forward if it feels good.

phases.name: Pigeon, right
phases.cue: Switch sides.

phases.name: Seated hamstring stretch
phases.cue: Both legs long, reach for your feet.

phases.name: Butterfly
phases.cue: Soles together.

phases.name: Supine twist
phases.cue: Thirty seconds each side.

phases.name: Rest
phases.cue: Lie still and breathe.

name: Pre-Run Warm-Up
blurb: Five minutes of moving stretches so your first mile feels good.

phases.name: March in place
phases.cue: High knees, swing your arms.

phases.name: Leg swings, front to back
phases.cue: Twenty each leg, hold something for balance.

phases.name: Leg swings, side to side
phases.cue: Twenty each leg.

phases.name: Walking lunges with a twist
phases.cue: Lunge, turn over the front knee.

phases.name: Hip circles
phases.cue: Hands on hips, big circles.

phases.name: Butt kicks
phases.cue: Quick and light.

phases.name: A-skips
phases.cue: Skip with a high knee.

phases.name: Strides
phases.cue: Three short build-ups to a fast run.

name: Post-Lift Cool-Down
blurb: Seven minutes after training to bring your heart rate down and loosen what you worked.

phases.name: Easy walk
phases.cue: Slow walk, deep breaths.

phases.name: Doorway chest stretch
phases.cue: Open the front of your shoulders.

phases.name: Lat stretch on a rack
phases.cue: Hold the rack, sit back, round your back.

phases.name: Couch stretch, left
phases.cue: Back knee against a bench.

phases.name: Couch stretch, right
phases.cue: Switch sides.

phases.name: Hamstring stretch
phases.cue: One leg up on a bench, fold over it.

phases.name: Child's pose
phases.cue: Arms long.

phases.name: Box breathing
phases.cue: Four in, four hold, four out, four hold.
